hints.text: Try getting the 5 out of the way first. What could you do to both sides?
You want the 3x alone. If you subtract 5 on both sides, what’s left on the right?
An equation stays balanced when you do the same thing to both sides. After undoing the + 5, you have 3x = 15. What undoes multiplying by 3?
Try a similar one: 2y + 3 = 7. Subtract 3 from both sides to get 2y = 4. Divide both sides by 2, so y = 2. Now try those moves on your equation.
Divide both sides of 3x = 15 by 3. Then put your result into the original equation to check it. You take the last step.
